description: SPEC-013 FR12 crash recovery. A prior /ship crashed mid-merge-loop leaving a half-merged state: T-001 is done (already merged), T-002 is in-progress (orphaned, NOT merged — its target src/feature-b.ts is absent), T-003 is pending. A stale planr-wt/T-002-* branch survives with no live worktree. On re-run the reconcile sweep (ship.md Step 1.10) MUST delete that branch BEFORE dispatch; then the status-aware queue (Step 2a) skips done, re-queues in-progress→pending, runs pending. The re-run must end with no duplicate ship.task record for T-001 (no double-merge), T-002 closed with a real ended_at, and T-001's already-merged file untouched.
